# OasisDeal

> OasisDeal compares flights and travel services for international travellers. It shows route guidance, destination planning, hotel comparisons, airport transfers, travel eSIM options, and flight-delay compensation information. Flight and partner prices are starting prices; the airline or partner sets the final price.

## Main sections

- Flights: https://oasisdeal.com/
- Flight routes: https://oasisdeal.com/flights/
- Destinations: https://oasisdeal.com/destinations/
- Travel guides: https://oasisdeal.com/blog/
- Hotels: https://oasisdeal.com/hotels
- Airport transfers: https://oasisdeal.com/transfers
- Travel eSIM: https://oasisdeal.com/esim
- Flight rights: https://oasisdeal.com/flight-rights
- About OasisDeal: https://oasisdeal.com/about

## Languages

English, French, and Arabic versions use `/fr/` and `/ar/` paths and are linked with hreflang metadata.

## Editorial and commercial notes

Content is written for travellers and should be checked against official airline, airport, government, and embassy sources before booking. OasisDeal may earn a commission from partner links at no extra cost to the traveller.
